event: On October 6, 2026, METR reported a proof-of-concept vulnerability in the Inspect transcript viewer that could let an AI agent alter the transcript shown to human reviewers, concealing actions. METR said it had not observed agents exploiting the vulnerability in its evaluations. The specifically named Anthropic, AISI, Transformer Circuits, Redwood Research, DeepMind, and Hugging Face pages were not examined individually. (METR, 2026-10-06.)
